steps.quote: Commencing at a point on the mean high water mark that is the most southerly point of the natural boundary of Thulin Lake

steps.until: the northernmost tip of the lake
steps.quote: thence northerly along the mean high water mark on the westerly natural boundary of the lake to the northernmost tip of the lake

steps.until: the right of way of Finn Bay Road
steps.quote: thence along a straight line due West to the right of way of Finn Bay Road
thence northwesterly along the right of way to its intersection with Norlund Road

steps.until: a point on the mean low water mark on the natural boundary of Thulin Passage

steps.until: the most southwesterly point of land bordering the entrance to Thulin passage
steps.quote: thence southerly along the natural boundary to the most southwesterly point of land bordering the entrance to Thulin passage

steps.until: the point of land southwest of Lund which is the northeasterly terminus of the Savary Island marine telephone cable
steps.quote: thence along a straight line easterly to the point of land southwest of Lund which is the northeasterly terminus of the Savary Island marine telephone cable

steps.until: a small unnamed bay approximately 500 m southeasterly from the telephone cable terminus point
steps.quote: thence southerly along the natural boundary to a small unnamed bay approximately 500 m southeasterly from the telephone cable terminus point
